contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0001 (pure HS only for smooth proper stacks) and with the forgetful-Leray bookkeeping already used by sibling findings FND-0015/FND-0027 (extension 0→H→R^1f_*Q→Q(-1)^{m-1}→0) and FND-0036 (H^D(M_{g,n})≅H^{D-1}(M_{g,n-1};R^1π_*Q) at the open-input degree). Primary MHS check: for C smooth projective of genus g and S a set of m≥1 points, Deligne’s theory yields the SES of MHS 0→H^1(C;Q)→H^1(C\S;Q)→Q(-1)^{m-1}→0, so Gr^W_1 has rank 2g (weight 1) and Gr^W_2 has rank m-1 (weight 2, Tate). For the universal n-punctured curve one has m=n, hence Tate rank n-1 as stated; pure weight 1 holds only for n≤1. For the campaign case (g,n)=(6,6), L=R^1π_*Q along M_{6,6}→M_{6,5} (or the universal 6-punctured system) therefore has weights ≥1, so H^p(base;L) has weights ≥p+1; at p=2d−k−1=25 one has lowest weight 26 and W_25=0, so any pure-corner label W_p at that spot is the zero group. Mild scope sharpening only: absolute ‘never pure of weight 1’ is for m≥2 (n≥2 universal, n≥3 forgetful); the (6,6) instance and the ATT-0011 error-pattern warning remain intact. Distinct from FND-0037/FND-0027 (non-split extension obstructing graded splitting of Leray terms) and from FND-0014 (uncontrolled symplectic local-system cohomology): do not merge. Promote from candidate to corroborated on independent primary-source verification of the mixed-weight structure and weight-floor consequence; evidence_class upgraded from legacy_artifact to primary_source. ATT-0011 section-level provenance was not re-audited (artifact absent from the read-only workspace) and is not required for the mathematical promotion.
